research_question: When teacher and student computational topologies differ, which distillation targets transfer useful behavior most effectively under a matched budget?

arms.question: What does conventional mapped intermediate-state matching achieve?
Does a faithful prediction-space feature-dynamics comparator outperform pointwise state KD?

prior_art.title: Beyond Logits: Aligning Feature Dynamics for Effective Knowledge Distillation
prior_art.adaptation_rule: Do not relabel residual hidden-state deltas as FDD. FDD maps selected intermediate representations through each model's prediction head and aligns trajectory and first-order prediction dynamics in a shared vocabulary space.

arms.question: Can a student layer reproduce the aggregate residual contribution of the teacher span it replaces?
Does local adjacent residual-transition supervision help when absolute hidden state is anchored?
arms.note: This is an internal abstraction ablation and must not be called FDD.

arms.question: Does topology-aware span supervision become useful when an absolute-state anchor prevents residual-stream drift?
Does the best anchored topology-aware objective translate to output behavior when combined with output-level supervision?
arms.note: Composite weights must be pre-registered in a protocol revision before GPU execution; they must not be chosen after seeing A-E results.

execution_gates: CPU_GATE: repository static preflight passes before renting GPU
IMPLEMENTATION_GATE: an arm is not GPU-eligible until its objective implementation and unit tests exist
PROTOCOL_GATE: all scientific hyperparameters are explicit; no CLI-default inheritance
DATA_GATE: corpus and tokenizer fingerprints match the registered hashes
STUDENT_GATE: the canonical transferred checkpoint identity is verified
RUNTIME_GATE: L40S runtime identity and critical software versions are captured before model loading
VRAM_GATE: peak training VRAM must remain below 45 GiB
ARTIFACT_GATE: manifest, resolved config, metrics, summary, memory record, command, and terminal state are present before an arm is considered complete
ANALYSIS_GATE: no longer-budget or context run starts until the objective comparison is interpreted
REPLICATION_GATE: a central result requires at least one additional seed

allowed: teacher/student/data path checks that require the pod filesystem
GPU memory calibration when a new objective changes memory behavior
GPU-dependent evaluation and inference memory measurement

claim_rules.historical_negative_result: Pure topology span-delta under Run004-M was trainable but underperformed pointwise KD on output/validation diagnostics at 128 steps; this does not establish that behavioral KD generally fails.
claim_rules.mechanistic_explanation_status: The idea that pure span-delta can learn the right movement from the wrong absolute state is a hypothesis until the functional audit tests it.
claim_rules.novelty: No first-in-literature claim without the registered prior-art comparator and a current literature review.
claim_rules.capability: 128-step mechanism comparisons are not capability results.
